refusal.what: The first real ConsciousConversation session was not run by this agent.
refusal.why: It requires a human SELFnode answering naturally. Were I to answer the probes, the transcript would be stamped HUMAN_SELFNODE and emitted as REAL_TRANSCRIPT — a fabricated corpus wearing the provenance of a real one. That is worse than no corpus, because it would look like data and would then flow through annotation into a coverage number.
refusal.structural_note: The runtime already distinguishes responder_kind, but only between HUMAN_SELFNODE and SCRIPTED_REPLAY. An agent typing answers into the human path is not a case the type system can catch. The guarantee here is a refusal, not a mechanism — stated plainly so it is not mistaken for one.
refusal.consequence: ON_DISTRIBUTION_SAMPLE_INSUFFICIENT is unchanged. Everything downstream of the session is built, interlocked and proven; none of it has run on real material.

F-002.reasoning_recorded: AWAKEN..INTEGRATE describes the EPISTEMIC JOURNEY. A Signal is not necessarily an intentional node act within it. Making CREATE_SIGNAL another state transition would mix the conversation FSM with SELFgraph construction — two different things that must not share a state machine.
F-002.gate_placement: Extraction PROPOSES; ontology validation ADJUDICATES; only then may a signal exist. The same shape as the E3 boundary — the half that looks at conversation has no power, and the half with power looks only at validated structure. Asserted by PILOT-34, which checks the ordering rather than trusting the prose.
F-002.scaffolding_made_structural: The successor architecture and the disposition are now carried in the ARTIFACT, not only in prose. Every GenesisRecord written by the scaffolding carries scaffolding=true, the disposition string, and the six-step successor pipeline, and those records are written into every transcript. A future reader finds the authorized design attached to each record the scaffolding produced, so 'we always did it this way' cannot quietly become the architecture (PILOT-33).
F-002.standing: OPEN — contained, declared, and now self-documenting. Not fixed, and not pretending to be.

BLIND_ORDER.ruling: Blind annotation precedes shadow. Do not inspect detector output before annotation.
BLIND_ORDER.defect_in_prior_design: ISA-009 shipped shadow runnable immediately after transcript freeze. Deferral proved that detector output could not exist DURING a conversation, but nothing stopped it existing BEFORE annotation — which is the ordering that actually protects the measurement. Blindness was left to discipline.
BLIND_ORDER.INV-CC-PILOT-BLIND-ORDER: Labels for a conversation must be frozen before any detector output for that conversation exists, and a detector run must refuse until they are.

interlock.runtime/annotate.py: REFUSES if a shadow record already exists for the conversation
interlock.runtime/shadow.py: REFUSES until frozen labels exist for the conversation
interlock.effect: Exactly one order is reachable. Blindness is not enforced by asking an annotator not to look; it is enforced by there being nothing to look at yet.
interlock.reachability: annotate.py imports neither kernel.e3 nor runtime.shadow — it CANNOT display detector output. Covered by the same AST sweep that polices the session modules.

BLIND_ORDER.scripted_exemption: A SCRIPTED_REPLAY transcript is exempt. Not a loophole: its spans are SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE, the coverage loader refuses them, and a transcript that can never be measured has no measurement to protect. Requiring annotation of a fixture would only mean fabricating labels.
BLIND_ORDER.cohort_and_partition: ON_DISTRIBUTION, partition discovery — permanently. First sessions inevitably influence architectural decisions, so they may never later serve as independent validation (INV-E3-COVERAGE-NO-RETROFIT).

SEALED_VS_BRANCH.ruling: Report sealed standing separately from branch revalidation, so extension-environment availability cannot semantically degrade a historical verified seal.
SEALED_VS_BRANCH.implementation: proof/check_sealed_baseline.py derives sealed verdicts from the SEALED TREE via `git cat-file blob <tag>:<path>` — never from the working tree. A branch may add, edit and delete freely; none of it reaches into a tag's tree.
SEALED_VS_BRANCH.anti_forgery: The recorded verdict is read from the SEALED copy of the gate evidence, which is itself covered by the manifest. Editing the working-tree copy of final-seal-gate.txt to read VERIFIED proves nothing, because the script never reads that file from disk. Asserted by PILOT-37.

findings.title: coverage/harness.py has no cohort awareness
findings.statement: cohorts.json is inert data that nothing reads. `report()` computes per-rule tallies over EVERY span it loaded. The two-cohort law — 'their metrics are never combined' — is currently upheld only by the corpus happening to contain a single cohort. The moment a second cohort enters corpus/discovery/, the merge is silent.
findings.containment: On-distribution labels go to coverage/corpus/ondist/ — a SEPARATE corpus root, not a folder inside the existing one. `load_corpus(<root>)` already takes a base path, so the cohorts measure independently with NO harness change, which is the correct move while the measurement apparatus is frozen. Asserted by PILOT-32.
findings.not_fixed: Making the harness cohort-aware is a change to the measurement apparatus and was not authorized. Recorded so the containment is not mistaken for a solution.
findings.authority_required: MILASOPHAHR — whether the harness gains cohort separation before the on-distribution cohort is ever measured alongside another.

findings.statement: ISA-20260814-CC-RUNTIME-PILOT-009 stated 'proof/gate.py is UNCHANGED by this phase.' True when written. The standing-report repair then changed it: render_standing() was added, and two verdict lines were relabelled to SELF INTEGRITY (BRANCH REVALIDATION) and E3 EXTENSION (BRANCH REVALIDATION).
findings.unchanged: MANDATORY_SUITES, STATIC_CONDITIONS, E3_DONE_CONDITIONS, gate_open(), self_integrity() and e3_status() are arithmetically untouched. Only two labels and one additive renderer.
findings.handling: ISA-009 is immutable and was NOT edited. The correction is declared in proof/evidence/BASELINE-DELTA.md and carried here. A superseding archive is the only legitimate way to correct a transmitted statement.
